sufficiency_witness: The zonation covers the whole core with zones A and B.
analysis_specification: Assign each sample the zone whose [top_cm, base_cm) interval contains its depth. Keep samples in zones A and B only; run one-way PERMANOVA (Bray–Curtis, relative abundances); report pseudo-F, R² and n.
